faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHSGU Project Associate-I recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the DHSGU Project Associate-I position is 21 August 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Associate-I post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess an M. Sc. or M. Tech degree in a relevant field of Plant Science or Allied Subjects to be eligible for the Project Associate-I position.

faq.question: Q3. How can I apply for this government job?
faq.answer: Applications for the DHSGU Project Associate-I recruitment must be submitted via email. You need to send your resume and required documents to the official email address specified in the notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Associate-I role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Associate-I position will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 30,000/- per month, plus HRA as per norms.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General, OBC, SC, ST) for the DHSGU Project Associate-I recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for this position?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Project Associate-I post at Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar involves an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and performance in the interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment drive is DHSGU-Bot/ANRF-S21646/34.

faq.question: Q8. Which organization is conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: This recruitment is being conducted by Dr. Harisingh Gour Vishwavidyalaya Sagar (DHSGU).

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this position?
faq.answer: The Project Associate-I position is a contractual role, meaning it is offered on a temporary basis for a specific project duration.

faq.question: Q10. Where is the job location for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The job location for this recruitment is Sagar, Madhya Pradesh.
